svg.title: Find the build failure report
svg.desc: A failed build opens a diagnostic folder. Under workshop root, InstallFailures, package ID and timestamp contain install-failure.txt. Read the first CS error, edit Sources, increase version after changing installed content, and rebuild.
svg.text: Build or install failed: find the report

g.text: File + line/column → fix the first error in Sources → rebuild
Example diagnostic only. Remove personal paths before sharing your actual report.
A failed build does not update the installed mod.
